scope: Pinned root AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md for Beacon, Entire and MFS, plus absence verification for agentglass

guidance_constraints.title: Telemetry scope and explicit network exceptions
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Normal hook execution must remain local and avoid network calls. The interactive installation wizard nevertheless requires account sign-in and can enable explicitly confirmed cloud forwarding. Signing in alone does not forward telemetry.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Reuse provenance and review invariants. Do not import Beacon onboarding, account requirements, forwarding or external-harness launch behavior into the independent HOI4 runtime.

guidance_constraints.title: Privacy and credential boundaries
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Guidance separates account and device credentials, limits where each can be stored, requires sanitization and field classification, and requires explicit sharing choices. The browser collector retains full content by default and has narrow site scope.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Telemetry retention is not project canon. Design the factory's own minimal retention and outbound-data grants. A local-first description does not prove that every optional workflow stays offline.

guidance_constraints.title: Observed evidence and stable identities
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Collection method and observed-versus-inferred fidelity are distinct markers. Runtime events, tool-call IDs and prompt IDs must retain source provenance. Deterministic event-ID derivation is a compatibility contract. Missing approval signals must not become observed approvals.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt the evidence distinctions and stable identity tests. Do not use telemetry-derived attribution as authorization or proof that a mod mutation settled.

guidance_constraints.title: Cost provenance
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Reported costs stay separate from catalog estimates. Pricing is computed offline for reports, ambiguous models remain unpriced, and catalog or override provenance is retained.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Use unknown-versus-estimated-versus-reported accounting. Do not copy Beacon's price catalog or claim actual billed costs from local estimates.

guidance_constraints.title: Derived history and readonly views
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: The local dashboard is read-only. Optional history must answer like the JSONL source scan, with derivation-version changes rebuilding projections. Handoff markers are observed claims rather than verified identity.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Supports rebuilding indexes from authoritative source. The history database and session handoff cannot replace factory grants, canon ownership or mutation receipts.

guidance_constraints.title: Security limits are explicit
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Lens guidance says browser sandbox and CSP hardening do not make trace exfiltration impossible. The optional hook policy seam is off by default and fails open on errors.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Neither a lens sandbox nor the Beacon policy seam is an adequate authoritative enforcement boundary for factory writes or untrusted executable extensions.

guidance_constraints.title: Canonical generated mirrors
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Agent skills, embedded runtime plugins, shared serializers, rule baselines and lens examples have canonical sources and equality tests. A changed command requires corresponding skill changes.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt canonical-source plus generated-mirror checks. Do not copy the complete upstream role or command inventory into factory instructions.

guidance_constraints.title: Verification and platform claims
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Go, npm and bun components have separate checks. The CLI test path requires building real embedded hooks first. Paid real-Claude verification requires the sandbox manual, is Linux-only and is distinct from hermetic tests. Guidance forbids claiming unsupported platforms as tested.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Any later reuse probe must isolate local settings and record the exact module/platform. No repository command, paid sandbox, service installation or test was run in this audit.

guidance_constraints.title: Release and contribution boundaries
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Guidance requires focused changes, explicit validation limits, pinned release actions, separation of untrusted PR code from signing, exact released-byte verification and maintainer approval before replacing a published tag.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: These are upstream contribution and release rules, not authority to publish, modify global settings or contact maintainers during factory planning.

guidance_tensions.description: CONTRIBUTING.md suggests t.Setenv("HOME", ...) for tests while CLAUDE.md specifies testenv.SetHome and explains that bare HOME changes do not move os.UserHomeDir on Windows.
guidance_tensions.resolution: For future upstream tests use the platform-aware helper after inspecting the target test contract. No tests were run here.

guidance_tensions.description: Short test command lists omit build-hooks-current, while CLAUDE.md says the CLI tests fail against the checked-in placeholder.
guidance_tensions.resolution: Include the real embedded-hook build prerequisite in any future relevant test plan.

guidance_constraints.title: Root guidance is a bounded router
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md. The root entry routes to task-specific references and has a 20 KiB budget with link checks. It should not accumulate command catalogs or subsystem histories.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt short shared guidance and targeted references. Retain the factory's portable file projections rather than introducing required symlinks.

guidance_constraints.title: Checkpoint metadata is not workspace restore
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: ManualCommitStrategy is the only strategy. Turn ends write session state and commits create checkpoint metadata refs. Guidance explicitly distinguishes log resume from restoring working files.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Reuse checkpoint metadata, attribution and compare-and-swap patterns. Entire does not provide the factory's full worktree rollback or transactional mod restoration.

guidance_constraints.title: Trusted roots and local settings provenance
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Filesystem work must use canonical anchored owners. Deriving a root from the requested target proves no confinement. Settings and readonly paths retain symlink policy. Repository-controlled settings cannot authorize executable discovery or permission-bypassed agents.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt trusted-root handles and local-provenance rejection tests. Imported mod instructions remain data and cannot grant filesystem or executable authority.

guidance_constraints.title: Git environment and preservation
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Repository operations use the repository abstraction, budgeted status and no-optional-locks where required. Inherited Git selectors and temporary hook indexes need different treatment depending on the query. Guidance warns that go-git checkout/reset can lose ignored or untracked directories.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Use isolated Git fixtures and preserve index semantics. Naming a Git operation in guidance is not authorization for destructive commands.

guidance_constraints.title: Identity, redaction and nonvisual access
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Caller resolution must retain provenance and avoid newest-session guesses. Transcript handling preserves sanitization, image externalization and redaction order. Readonly workflows require complete text or JSON access. Operational logs must omit prompts, file contents and commit messages.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt identity provenance and nonvisual parity. Do not treat a session guess or imported transcript as project authority.

guidance_constraints.title: Tests isolate real user state
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Tests must use temporary repositories and isolated config, caches, keyrings and spawned-process environments. Current-tree lint and the complete check task are required at commit/push boundaries. Real-agent E2E requires explicit user request because it incurs cost, with a deterministic canary as the free exception.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: A future upstream contribution needs these gates. This read-only audit executed neither the canary nor real-agent tests and made no commits or pushes.

guidance_constraints.title: Upstream contribution and sharing expectations
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: CONTRIBUTING asks for maintainer-aligned issues before ordinary implementation, review of automated feedback and self-review of AI changes. Its dogfooding workflow includes checkpoint trailers and optional session-branch publication.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: These expectations apply to contributing upstream. They do not authorize publishing private factory development sessions, installing Entire, opening issues or sending messages during this planning task.

guidance_tensions.description: CONTRIBUTING describes the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch for session sharing, while CLAUDE describes the current commit-time metadata-ref contract and explicitly excludes worktree restoration.
guidance_tensions.resolution: Treat the exact inspected implementation as authoritative for storage layout. Neither wording establishes a worktree restore API or permission to share session content.

guidance_constraints.title: Server owns retrieval behavior
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: The Rust CLI is only an HTTP client. The Python FastAPI server owns connectors, ingest, vector indexing and storage. SDKs are generated from OpenAPI. The Rust acceleration wheel has a Python fallback and is optional.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Full MFS adoption adds a service and storage boundary. Do not treat its Rust CLI as an embeddable standalone memory engine.

guidance_constraints.title: Thin connector contract
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Connectors expose path trees, read or read_records, fingerprints, sync and fixed object classification. They must not write vectors, embeddings or caches directly. New object_kind or chunk_kind values require a framework change.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt capability and change-detection contracts. A HOI4-specific adapter must preserve framework boundaries rather than bypassing them to update indexes.

guidance_constraints.title: Index and metadata reconciliation
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Guidance declares correspondence between committed object metadata and vector chunks, with a directory-summary exception. Cancellation, removal and startup cleanup must reconcile the shared embed consumer. Metadata, vectors, artifacts and transformation cache are distinct stores.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Supports explicit reconciliation and derived-index ownership. The declared invariant is not proof of one atomic transaction across these stores or a completed correctness test.

guidance_constraints.title: Code is the configuration authority
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Connector implementation, wizard subset, agent skill and human documentation must agree, with code authoritative. Credentials use env or file references resolved by the framework and are not plaintext TOML values.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Adapt code-to-guidance drift checks and secret references. Do not copy a connector's local environment or grant its source implied access to private mod content.

guidance_constraints.title: Capability and deletion claims must be honest
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Advertised pushdown and cursor capabilities must reflect implemented behavior. Connector design must name listing cost, fingerprints, indexed fields, delete-detection tier and minimum credential scope. Search hits retain locators and stable path conventions.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Use measured connector coverage and source freshness. Do not treat an absent search hit as proof that source content was deleted or never existed.

guidance_constraints.title: Guidance does not claim test-gated CI
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Python tests require the dev extra, optional connector dependencies can prevent collection, and live API tests are explicitly marked. Guidance says CI enforces formatting and does not gate tests. It separately describes a version-lockstep CI job.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Green formatting or version checks cannot establish retrieval or cancellation correctness. No MFS tests or live connectors were executed in this audit.

guidance_constraints.title: Agent-agnostic skill surface
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: The ingestion and search skills describe intent and the MFS CLI/API rather than coupling to a particular agent UI.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Reuse the provider-neutral workflow principle. The factory remains independent from MFS and from any developer coding CLI.

guidance_constraints.title: Lockstep release and upstream contribution
guidance_constraints.status: Verified guidance content, runtime behavior unexecuted
guidance_constraints.statement: Versions across client, server, SDKs, acceleration package and deployment tags are manually changed and checked together. A version tag triggers publication. CONTRIBUTING states submitted contributions use Apache-2.0.
guidance_constraints.reuse_boundary: Any eventual dependency update needs a pinned closure and migration evidence. Guidance does not authorize releases or expand the prior dependency-license audit.

absence.limitation: Absence of these filenames does not imply the repository has no useful README, security policy or subsystem documentation
